job.title: Junior Machine Learning Engineer (Recommendation Systems)
job.description: ShopSmart Technologies (Mumbai) runs an e-commerce intelligence platform. We are seeking a Junior ML Engineer to build personalized recommendation pipelines using collaborative filtering, two-tower models, implicit feedback, and Redis feature stores.

pool.text: Recommendation Algorithms: matrix factorization, ALS, collaborative filtering, and Two-Tower neural models
TensorFlow / PyTorch for RecSys: built deep ranking and candidate retrieval models using PyTorch
Feature Store & Redis: served low-latency user embeddings and item feature vectors from Redis
Ranking Evaluation Metrics: evaluated Hit Rate@K, NDCG@K, MRR, and Precision@K
BookMatch: personalized reading recommendation engine utilizing implicit user click logs and embeddings
B.E. Computer Science, Mumbai University (SPIT), 2022–2026, CGPA 8.6/10
Data Pipeline with Spark / PySpark: executed distributed matrix transformations on user transaction data
React frontend: built a calculator using Vite and JavaScript
Data Science Intern at RetailAI (Mumbai, 3 months): optimized cross-sell product suggestions module
Python & Scikit-learn: created baseline models and preprocessing transformers
Graphic Design: designed college fest mascot in Adobe Illustrator
A/B Testing Methodology: statistical hypothesis testing, sample size calculation, and p-value validation
